plain_english_policy: Supporting the legalization of physician-assisted suicide (PAS) is conventionally a progressive stance, as it aligns with arguments for patient autonomy, end-of-life dignity, and reducing suffering in terminally ill individuals. Conservative opposition often frames PAS as morally equivalent to euthanasia or a slippery slope toward devaluing life.
